row.scim_plan: Enterprise agreement (enabled per organization by BetterUp)
row.evidence: BetterUp sells only through sales ("fill out the form and our sales team will be in touch"), and its help centre says "SCIM provisioning is enabled on a per-organization basis by BetterUp. Talk to your BetterUp account team before you begin."
row.notes: New row. BetterUp (enterprise coaching) publishes no prices; every agreement is Contact Sales, and SCIM 2.0 must be switched on per organization by the account team, so gated follows the Contact Sales rule. SCIM uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials (scim:user/group read/write scopes) at api.betterup.co/scim/v2; DELETE and active=false both soft-deactivate (records kept, reactivation keeps history); groups map to roles and programs. The public OpenAPI spec is still titled "SCIM API (Coming Soon)" v0.0.1 while the August 2026 help article describes SCIM as live (see conflicts). No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app was found; IdPs connect to the generic endpoint. Licences are driven by the HCM/SFTP feed, not SCIM. The Partner API (OAuth client credentials) exposes read-only user listing, licence summaries and a security audit-log API. support.betterup.com HTML returns 403 to bots, so help-centre quotes cite the Zendesk JSON API with page_url set.

plans.name: BetterUp enterprise agreement
plans.notes: Products (leadership development, manager effectiveness, AI coaching) are sold by quote; Enterprise Flex vs seat-based agreements are mentioned in the SCIM article.

scim.plan: Enterprise agreement (enabled per organization by BetterUp)

auth.token_source: Partner admin settings: create an API credential with SCIM scopes (OAuth 2.0 client credentials)

operations.notes: DELETE on /Users soft-deactivates rather than deleting; group DELETE soft-discards the group and revokes its role bindings.

deprovision.data_retained: Member record and history are retained for audit and reporting; the account can be reactivated.

custom.how: Attributes outside the documented core lists are ignored

roles.how: Group-to-role mapping on the SCIM Groups page; groups can also assign programs

limitations.text: Group-driven program assignment has no seat-limit enforcement; BetterUp recommends other methods for seat-based agreements.
Groups created in BetterUp do not sync back to the IdP; nested groups are not supported.
No webhooks or event callbacks for provisioning events.
Licence and eligibility changes come from the HCM feed, not SCIM.

capabilities.notes: The published Partner API spec has read-only user endpoints; write scopes exist but no user write endpoints are documented.

rate_limits.text: They vary by endpoint and plan - ask your BetterUp representative before building high-volume integrations.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/betterup/ and variants return 404; the vendor says Okta connects via SCIM 2.0.

entra.notes: No Learn tutorial at betterup-tutorial or betterup-provisioning-tutorial (404).

fallbacks.other_sync: HCM integration (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle, UKG API pull or SFTP file feed)
fallbacks.notes: CSV upload is handled by BetterUp, not self-serve.

Whether deactivation frees a licence or ends sessions is not documented.
Which SSO plan/contract includes SAML is not stated; SSO appears to be available to all enterprise customers.
